findings.summary: scripts/validate_evidence.py lines 80-103 do not validate migration-object identity or several required provenance fields. Wrong binding_id, malformed observed_at, and an arbitrary valid migration_candidate_tree are accepted; fetch_migrations keys the canonical ref only by the legacy JSON hash and trusts the replacement object's self-declared parent. A writer can move the migration ref to a different commit with altered migration provenance while complete-ledger validation still passes. Validate the full binding schema and deterministic binding ID, timestamp/cutoff, exact migration candidate/tree relationship, expected immutable object identity or an append-only declaration that binds it, and add moved-ref/wrong-object regression tests.

The real append-only ledger has no valid modern repair/recheck edges for REVIEW-05-F1 or REVIEW-05-F3. REVIEW-06 only republishes those finding IDs as CLOSED inside its own legacy record; because finding identity includes the source Gate Record and supersession does not close predecessor findings, REVIEW-05's original OPEN MAJOR facts remain unresolved. Publish exact implementation repair claims and distinct independent rechecks for the original REVIEW-05 finding keys, and add a real-ledger regression proving every historical serious finding has a valid lifecycle.

The PR work record's current CI evidence is contradictory: the evidence table correctly cites run 32408398957, but the next paragraph calls older run 32405167159 the exact-current-candidate run. Correct the stale paragraph and explicitly label the older run historical before Release authorization.
